story.originalTitle: Williams confirms F1 2027 line-up with Sainz extension
story.summaryEn: Williams has announced a multi-year contract extension for Carlos Sainz, confirming its 2027 Formula 1 driver line-up. The news comes a day after team-mate Alex Albon agreed to just a one-season extension.
detailZh: 威廉姆斯确认2027年F1阵容，塞恩斯续约
这位四届大奖赛冠军得主签下了一份多年续约合同，尽管他在2026年F1赛季随威廉姆斯经历了艰难的一年。
威廉姆斯在宣布卡洛斯·塞恩斯签下多年合同后，确认了其2027年F1赛季的车手阵容。
这位西班牙人的消息传出前一天，队友亚历克斯·阿尔本仅同意续约一年，明年将是他效力这支位于格罗夫的车队的第六个赛季。
对塞恩斯而言，2027年将是他在威廉姆斯的第三个赛季，尽管2026年十分艰难，车队在11轮后以仅11分排名第九，且最近五场比赛一分未得。
“我很高兴宣布继续与威廉姆斯F1车队大家庭同行，”塞恩斯说道，他从法拉利加盟，在那里赢得了四场大奖赛。
“我真心相信这支团队的成员，无论是工厂还是赛道上的人，以及幕后正在进行的投资和辛勤工作。
“我们有能力一起扭转局面。我像第一天一样致力于帮助威廉姆斯回到它应有的位置。
“我期待与车队创造更多回忆。”
亚历山大·阿尔本，威廉姆斯，卡洛斯·塞恩斯，威廉姆斯
考虑到2026年进展如此糟糕，塞恩斯的续约可能最初令人意外，他未能延续2025年的势头，当时他的两次领奖台帮助威廉姆斯获得第五名——这是车队自2017年以来的最高年度排名。
这支英国车队在2026年规则变更之初推出了一辆超重赛车，削减重量成为整个赛季的主要焦点，或许牺牲了空气动力学研发。
因此，随着塞恩斯的合同在2026年底到期，关于他可能寻求明年转会的猜测变成了纷争，但他唯一的选择将是另一支中游车队。
因此，这位31岁的车手将留在威廉姆斯，迎来车队在F1的第50个赛季，期间车队已赢得九次制造商冠军、七次车手冠军和114场大奖赛胜利。
威廉姆斯认为塞恩斯的续约“反映了双方建立的信任，因为威廉姆斯继续在F1中挑战所需的所有领域进行投资，并增添其传奇”。
车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯补充道：“从他加入的那一刻起，卡洛斯在方向盘后的天赋和在工厂的奉献精神对这个项目极为宝贵——与他的工程师日复一日地合作，寻找每一毫秒。
卡洛斯·塞恩斯，威廉姆斯，詹姆斯·沃尔斯，威廉姆斯
“他是这支车队的领袖，我很高兴他能看到我们继续重建时的可能性。
“突出的不仅是他的赛车技巧和速度，还有他在幕后为追求高性能所做的工作。
“卡洛斯与威廉姆斯有着共同的信念和雄心，并每天都在推动实现它。
“与亚历克斯一起，我真心相信我们拥有围场中最强大的阵容之一，以及一支能够共同争取每一分性能的车队。”
detailEn: Williams confirms F1 2027 line-up with Sainz extension
The four-time grand prix winner has signed a multi-year extension, despite a torrid season with Williams in F1 2026
Williams has confirmed its driver line-up for the 2027 Formula 1 season after announcing the commitment of Carlos Sainz on a multi-year deal.
The Spaniard’s news comes a day after team-mate Alex Albon agreed just a one-season extension for next year, which will be the Thai-Briton’s sixth campaign with the Grove outfit.
For Sainz, 2027 will be his third season at Williams and comes despite a torrid 2026 as the team is ninth in the standings after 11 rounds, with just 11 points and none from the last five races.
“I’m thrilled to announce my continued journey with the Williams F1 Team family,” said Sainz, who joined from Ferrari where he won four grands prix.
“I truly believe in the people that form this team, both at the factory and at the race tracks, and the investments and hard work that are happening in the background.
“We have what it takes to turn this around together. I’m as committed as I was on day one to helping get Williams back to where it belongs.
“I look forward to creating more memories with the team.”
Alexander Albon, Williams, Carlos Sainz, Williams

Sainz’s commitment may come as an initial surprise considering how poor 2026 has gone, failing to kick on from 2025 where his two podiums helped Williams finish fifth - its highest championship position since 2017.
The British outfit started the 2026 regulation change with an overweight car and cutting this has been its main focus throughout the season, perhaps at the expense of developing aerodynamically.
So speculation became strife that Sainz was potentially looking to move on for next year with his contract expiring at the end of 2026, but his only option would have been another midfield team.
The 31-year-old will therefore remain for Williams’ 50th season in F1, having since won nine constructors’ titles, seven drivers’ championships and 114 grand prix victories.
Williams reckons Sainz’s extension “reflects the trust both sides have built as Williams continues investing in all areas needed to challenge in F1 and add to its legacy”.

Team boss James Vowles added: "From the moment he joined, Carlos’ talent behind the steering wheel and dedication back at the factory have been extremely valuable for this project - working day in, day out with his engineers to find every millisecond.
Carlos Sainz, Williams, James Vowles, Williams
“He is a leader of this team, and I’m thrilled that he can see what’s possible as we continue to rebuild it.
“It’s not just his racecraft and speed that stand out, but the work he does behind the scenes in the pursuit of high performance.
“Carlos shares the belief and ambition we have at Williams and is pushing every day to deliver it.
“Along with Alex, I truly believe we have one of the strongest line-ups on the grid, and a team capable of fighting for every ounce of performance together."
keyPointsZh: 2027年将是塞恩斯效力威廉姆斯的第三个赛季，也是阿尔本在威廉姆斯的第六个赛季。
威廉姆斯在2026赛季前11轮后以11分排名第九，最近五场比赛未得分。
塞恩斯从法拉利加盟威廉姆斯，曾赢得四场大奖赛胜利。
keyPointsEn: 2027 will be Sainz's third season at Williams and Albon's sixth campaign with the team.
Williams is ninth in the standings after 11 rounds of 2026 with 11 points and none from the last five races.
Sainz joined Williams from Ferrari, where he won four grands prix.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.
